title: Unify SDKs: auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity + version bump v1.126.0
author: Ava Martinez
description: Context: This PR unifies auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics (backpressure and reconnect handling), and fixes parity gaps discovered during cross-language QA. Motivation: multiple customers hit inconsistent retry semantics and streaming edge-cases when switching between SDKs; unify behavior to reduce cognitive load for integrators and eliminate subtle production bugs. What changed: 1) Auth: canonicalize token refresh flow and error surface (401 handling) so all SDKs expose the same public hook names and events; 2) Retries: introduce a common retry policy config (max_attempts, backoff_factor, idempotency hints) and enforce only on idempotent endpoints; 3) Streaming: add backpressure signals for incremental readers, improved reconnect with resume (client-side sequence tracking) and clearer error propagation; 4) Ergonomics: rename a few high-friction helpers (open_stream -> stream, create_client -> Client.from_env), add typed overloads in TS and annotated stubs in Python; 5) Parity fixes: align call signatures and default timeouts across languages; 6) Version bump: prepare SDK releases v1.126.0 (py/ts/go). Testing: unit tests added/updated across all SDKs, end-to-end smoke tests against the staging inference gateway, local matrix tests for streaming reconnect/resume, and a small compatibility test running legacy clients. CI notes: initial pipeline showed a flaky streaming integration test in TS only; root cause addressed (race in test harness) and pipeline re-ran successfully. Migration notes: most changes are backwards-compatible; if your code relied on the old helper names use the provided deprecation shims for one minor release. Checklists: - [x] API parity matrix updated - [x] Docs snippets regenerated - [x] Changelog and release notes prepared - [x] QA: cross-language streaming smoke ✅ - [x] Security review (token handling) ✅
